_comment: Inbox-only spellings. Keys are norm() (lowercase, alphanumeric). names values are Steam64 ids from data/steamid_to_name.txt or data/processed/player_slugs.json. maps values are data/map-registry.json keys. Dom is Domakus. draconis, draconic, and draconismarchvii are DraconisMarch (not the separate player Dracon). clovis and clovisbray are Certified Bad Guy, as is cbg. tsahalis and tsahaliswas are HappyOtter. Do not copy these into the F9 ledger maps.
